Facial Volume Harmony

Lesson 15

In this lesson, we will work with the eye area.

Notice the eye area. Visible changes after 1 year of consistent practice.

Monthly Plan

  1. Practice the “Cobra” exercise every day, as often and for as long as possible.
  2. Perform the upper jaw expansion exercise daily, completing 3 sets.
  3. Practice the cheek volume exercise daily, completing 3 sets on each side.
  4. Perform the forehead and frown line exercises daily.
  5. Practice the nasolabial fold exercise daily, completing 3 sets on each side.
  6. Perform the jawline and youthful the lower jaw.
  7. Practice the eye area exercises daily.
  8. Continue relaxing the back of the head, jaw muscles, and tongue as needed.

If desired, after 3 months you may reduce the number of exercises and keep only those that are most relevant to your individual aesthetic goals.
